inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted-average count from the H1 2026 interim EPS note (6,091.1m basic ex shares held by the share-award trust + 44.9m dilutive options/awards = 6,136.0m). Shares in issue were 6,195.2m at 10 April 2026 (no treasury shares at 30 June 2026); the ~104m gap is shares bought and held by the share-award trust that will be delivered against awards already expensed as SBC. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count).
inputs.net_cash_composition: At 30 June 2026 (RMB m): bank balances and cash 3,956.0 + short-term bank deposits over three months 4,722.8 + restricted deposits 0.3 + long-term bank deposits 0.9 + other financial assets (investment notes at amortised cost) 4,595.7 + financial assets at FVTPL (wealth-management products) 2,227.3 = 15,503.1 gross financial assets; less advances drawn on bills receivable discounted with recourse 335.0 = net cash 15,168.1. Lease liabilities (314.3) are EXCLUDED because leases are charged as an operating cost in the flows (treatment B). The US$80m zero-coupon note referenced in the Analysis JSON is a note Smoore SUBSCRIBED to (an asset inside other financial assets), not borrowing; the only borrowing on the balance sheet is the discounted-bills advance.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based payment expenses' RMB467,991k (6969.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:4900). No net-share-settlement tax line exists (HK filer; awards satisfied from trust-held shares), so sbc_incl_equity_taxes equals the add-back.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 'Purchase of shares under share award scheme' RMB181.5m (financing activities); H1 2026 RMB202.6m. The flat share count is being funded in cash through the award-scheme trust, so the convention matches company practice.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate is CNY->HKD (multiply CNY per-share values by 1.1748 to get HKD): Yahoo CNYHKD=X 1.1748 at 2026-10-23T17:43Z. Parity checks: USDHKD 7.8433 / USDCNY 6.6596 = 1.1777 and 1/HKDCNY 0.8503 = 1.1761 (both Yahoo, 2026-10-23), i.e. within 0.25%, confirming the rate and the direction. No dual listing exists for a cross-listing parity check. refresh_price.py moves the price but never this rate; re-derive at the next update.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z HKEX regular close (Yahoo chart API); 52-week range 6.90-14.44
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% risk-free + 7.0% equity risk premium (China/HK-listed operating company) x beta ~1.1 = ~9.5% cost of equity. Borrowings are RMB335m of discounted bills against RMB15.2bn of financial assets, so WACC = cost of equity = 9.5%. Same rate in all three scenarios: regulatory, customer-concentration and margin risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B) - leases as operating cost. The full lease cash charge (FY2025 principal RMB121.1m + lease/bills interest RMB26.5m = ~1.0% of revenue; H1 2026 62.5m + 13.5m = 1.05%) is deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path, lease liabilities (RMB314.3m) are excluded from net debt, and da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PP&E depreciation 476.5 + amortisation 30.7 = 507.2 = 3.6% of revenue; ROU depreciation 176.2 excluded; 6969.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:6568-6570).
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are RMB42.1m of equity (Transpire Bio minority, 0.2% of group equity) and absorbed a RMB2.6m loss share in H1 2026. Immaterial: flows are modelled as 100% consolidated with no NCI deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: vaping/HNB device ODM plus self-branded VAPORESSO; not a bank/REIT/LIC), 10-year explicit horizon because margins are still moving. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry). EBITDA MARGIN BASIS: operating EBITDA before SBC and post-IFRS-16, EXCLUDING all interest income, FX and financial-asset gains (which belong to the RMB15.5bn financial-asset pile added back in the bridge, per the matching-asset rule) but INCLUDING government grants and other operating income. FY2025 on that basis: gross profit 4,857 - distribution 913 - admin 1,286 - R&D 1,523 + other income ex-interest (557-633 = -76, which contains a one-off RMB176m litigation settlement) + SBC 468 + D&A 683 = 2,210 = 15.5% (16.7% ex the litigation charge); H1 2026 = 1,109 / 7,209 = 15.4%; H1 2025 17.1%; FY2024 17.3%; FY2023 ~21.6%. The margin has fallen every year with the gross margin (53.6% FY2021 -> 34.1% FY2025 -> 32.2% H1 2026). INTEREST INCOME is 43% of FY2025 profit before tax (633 of 1,476): the owner-FCF strip is large and is why owner FCF (-1,464m FY2025, -168m H1 2026) is far below reported earnings; the financial assets that earn it are credited at face in net cash. Owner FCF was also hit in FY2025 by a RMB1.0bn working-capital build (HNB receivables and inventory ramp) that is not treated as recurring at that rate. TIMING: FY0 is FY2025 (December year-end) and year 1 is FY2026, discounted a full period from a late-October 2026 valuation date, which is conservative; the balance sheet is the latest (30 June 2026), after H1 2026's RMB1,058m dividend and RMB203m buybacks left the cash pile, so the set-up slightly under-credits value (~RMB0.18/share) rather than over-crediting it. TAX: FY2025 effective rate 28% of PBT, but ~38% of post-SBC operating EBIT (15% preferential PRC rate inflated by non-deductible SBC, unrecognised Transpire losses, overseas rates and withholding tax); cash tax paid RMB318m. The cash tax path starts at 30% of modelled EBIT and glides to 26% as SBC falls as a share of revenue and Transpire is externally financed.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 5-year forward revenue CAGR (FY2025 -> FY2030) from the HNB ramp; the historical anchors are unusable as a forward proxy: equity 5y CAGR (12.0%) is inflated by the July-2020 IPO proceeds in the FY2020 base, equity 3y is 2.4% because retained earnings are paid out, and diluted EPS compounded at -16.5% (5y) / -25.0% (3y) through four consecutive years of falling profit
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5y CAGR +12.0% diverges by far more than 30% from EPS 5y CAGR -16.5% and revenue 5y CAGR +7.3%: the balance sheet grew on IPO cash while earnings halved. Owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined because the owner-FCF series is negative in FY2022, FY2024 and FY2025 (FY2020 +2,200; FY2021 +912; FY2022 -2,021; FY2023 +1,149; FY2024 -136; FY2025 -1,464): reported FCF CAGR (also negative-ended) and owner-FCF CAGR cannot be compared, but SBC rose from 1.7% to 3.3% of revenue between FY2024 and FY2025 while reported FCF turned negative, so an increasing share of what growth there is, is being paid for in stock.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on FY2020->FY2025 (5y) and FY2022->FY2025 (3y) from metrics_normalized; EPS is diluted RMB (0.4217 -> 0.1711; 0.4062 -> 0.1711); equity attributable (12,399.7 -> 21,847.5; 20,377.2 -> 21,847.5).

base.narrative: FY2026 +17% (H1 2026 was +19.9%; H2 laps a stronger FY2025 H2 of RMB8.2bn). HNB keeps compounding off the glo Hilo rollout to further markets, the compliant US vape market recovers modestly after the May-2026 FDA shift, and European closed-system share gains offset disposable bans; growth decays to 3% by year 10. Operating EBITDA margin recovers from 15.5% to 19% by year 8 as HNB scales, the FY2025 litigation charge does not recur, Transpire's ~RMB260m/yr loss is financed externally and R&D intensity drifts down; it never regains the 20%+ of FY2023 because the gross margin stays near 32-34% on HNB/special-purpose mix. SBC 2.8% of revenue gliding to 2.0%; capex 6% gliding to 5% against D&A ex-ROU of 3.7%; working capital consumes 15% of each year's revenue increase (receivables + inventory of RMB3.7bn vs payables RMB1.6bn); cash tax 30% gliding to 26%. Terminal 3% growth, cap 15x owner FCF.

bull.narrative: HNB becomes a second core: glo Hilo rolls out across BAT's footprint and a second tobacco major signs on, taking HNB from RMB1.3bn (FY2025) to a multi-billion line by FY2028; the FDA's flavoured-ENDS authorisations and enforcement against illicit disposables hand Smoore's compliant ODM customers back US share; EU disposable bans consolidate volume with compliant pod makers. Revenue compounds 22%/18%/15% then decays. Operating EBITDA margin rebuilds to 23% (still below FY2022's 29%) on HNB scale, R&D leverage and Transpire leaving the P&L; SBC trends to 1.5%; working capital drag eases to 12% of growth as the ramp matures. Same 9.5% WACC, 3% terminal growth, 15x cap.

bear.narrative: FY2026 still grows 12% on H1 momentum, then the HNB ramp plateaus as BAT dual-sources the Hilo platform and glo's Japan share gains stall against IQOS; US enforcement priorities swing back (as they have before) and illicit disposables retake the share compliant customers had recovered; further EU/UK flavour restrictions and China's December-2025 crackdown shrink addressable volume. Revenue stalls at 1-2% from FY2028. Mix keeps grinding the gross margin toward 30%, so operating EBITDA margin slides to 12.5%; SBC stays elevated at ~3% as retention becomes harder; Transpire is not financed out and keeps costing ~RMB250m/yr; the tax rate stays at FY2025's 32% effective level on operating EBIT. Terminal growth 2%, 15x cap, same 9.5% WACC. Not a solvency case: RMB15bn of net cash underwrites the equity even here.

scenario_narratives.base: HNB compounds off the BAT glo Hilo rollout (RMB1.3bn FY2025, +322% YoY in H1 2026) while the legacy vaping ODM book grows mid-single digits on compliant-market share gains; revenue +17% FY2026 decaying to 3% by year 10. Operating EBITDA margin (pre-SBC, ex-interest, post-IFRS-16) recovers from 15.5% to 19% as HNB scales, the FY2025 litigation charge drops out and Transpire is externally financed, but the gross margin never returns to the 40%+ of FY2021-22. Owner FCF is thin for the first years because working capital absorbs 15% of growth and cash tax runs ~30% of EBIT; most value is terminal plus the RMB15.2bn net financial-asset pile (HK$2.90/share).
scenario_narratives.bull: HNB becomes a second core business with a second tobacco-major customer and multi-market glo Hilo rollout; the FDA's May-2026 flavoured-product authorisations and illicit-market enforcement restore compliant US volumes; EU disposable bans consolidate pod volume with Smoore. Revenue +22%/18%/15% then decays; operating EBITDA margin rebuilds to 23%; SBC drifts to 1.5% of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bear: HNB plateaus as BAT dual-sources and glo stalls against IQOS; US enforcement swings back, illicit disposables retake share, EU/UK flavour rules and China's crackdown shrink the compliant market. Revenue +12% in FY2026 then 1-2%; operating EBITDA margin slides to 12.5% on mix; SBC stays ~3%; Transpire's losses persist. Value is mostly the net cash; the operating business is worth little on this path.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: the growth thesis rests on one customer relationship (BAT glo Hilo) in an industry where regulators have reversed course repeatedly, reported profit has fallen four years running, the gross margin has halved since FY2021, and owner FCF has been negative in three of the last four years. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs HNB scaling, a US compliant-market recovery and a margin rebuild to happen together. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Smoore is valued as an operating company on strict owner FCF: SBC expensed (RMB468m in FY2025, 3.3% of revenue) with the share count held flat, and all RMB633m of interest income stripped from the flows with the RMB15.5bn of bank deposits, investment notes and FVTPL products that earn it credited at face in the bridge. That split matters more here than for most tickers: interest income is 43% of profit before tax, so the operating business earns far less than the headline RMB1.06bn net profit suggests, and the market's HK$51bn capitalisation (EV ~RMB28.5bn after net cash) is paying ~35-40x operating NOPAT for the HNB ramp. Margins are built from components (operating EBITDA ex-interest, SBC, lease cost, D&A ex-ROU, cash tax, capex, working capital on the revenue change) over a 10-year horizon because they are still moving; the terminal value is capped at 15x owner FCF for a regulatory-exposed, Shenzhen-based manufacturer; one 9.5% CNY WACC across scenarios with risk carried in the flows and in a 25/50/25 weighting.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: HNB growth is a single BAT platform (glo Hilo) and BAT keeps multiple ODM relationships; a dual-sourcing decision or a weak glo share trajectory against IQOS would push the outcome toward the bear path.
Regulatory whiplash: US FDA PMTA/enforcement posture, EU/UK flavour and disposable bans and China's December-2025 crackdown can each move revenue by double digits in a year, in either direction.
Margin mix: gross margin 53.6% (FY2021) to 32.2% (H1 2026); the base case assumes operating EBITDA margin recovers 3.5pp to 19%, which has not yet started.

Financial-asset pile: RMB6.8bn of the RMB15.5bn is investment notes at amortised cost and FVTPL wealth-management products rather than bank deposits; they are credited at carrying value, and a credit or liquidity event in those instruments would hit the bridge directly.

Cash tax and SBC: effective tax on operating EBIT ran ~38% in FY2025 and H1 2026 tax provisions rose 45% on 'international expansion'; SBC doubled in FY2025. Both are modelled to ease, which is a judgment.

Working capital: FY2025 absorbed RMB1.0bn (41% of the revenue increase) in receivables and inventory; the model assumes 15% going forward, so a second ramp year at FY2025's intensity would wipe out the next two years of owner FCF.

FX: revenue is largely USD/EUR against RMB costs and reporting (RMB164m H1 2026 FX loss, hedged by RMB200m of forward gains); and the HKD quote is bridged at a single CNY/HKD rate that refresh_price.py does not update.
